name: jev-skill-router
description: A UserPromptSubmit hook that asks TypeSafe Jev which of your installed skills fits the prompt — two typed requests over the whole roster (user, plugin and project skills), at most one skill name back. Runs in shadow mode by default: it records what it would have suggested to a JSONL decision log and injects nothing, so you can measure the recipe before letting it speak.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Key for the TypeSafe System One API. Optional: leave it empty to pass the key as the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable, or to keep it in a file named by JEV_ROUTER_KEY_FILE (default ~/.config/typesafe/api_key). With no key anywhere the hook logs a no-api-key row and does nothing else.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow records what it would have suggested and injects nothing (the default — measure before you trust it); inject adds a one-line pointer to the prompt's context when a suggestion clears the gate; off disables the hook. The JEV_ROUTER environment variable overrides this per process.

log_path.title: Decision log path
log_path.description: Where to append the JSONL decision log. Defaults to decisions.jsonl inside this plugin's own data directory. The file is created 0600 and a symlink in its place is refused.
